title: Ender of Death
translation: Like a bee lost in the sweet, flowing nectar of the blossoming arts of Sarvamangala (Parvati), he delights in its sweetness. I worship him, the ender of Kama, of Tripura, of worldly existence, of the sacrifice, of the elephant demon, of Andhaka, and the ender of death itself.
translation_hi: जो सर्वमंगला पार्वती की कलाओं रूपी मंजरी के रस प्रवाह की मधुरता पर मुग्ध भौंरे के समान हैं, उन शिव को मैं भजता हूँ, जो कामदेव, त्रिपुर, संसार, दक्ष यज्ञ, गजासुर और अंधकासुर का अंत करने वाले हैं, और स्वयं मृत्यु का भी अंत करने वाले हैं।

words.note: 'Whose vow is honey'. A third word for bee, after ali and bhringa in the Lilavati bee verse!

grammar: Same list, new word: verse 9 used -च्छिद् (cutter); this verse repeats the list with -अन्तक (ender). A good way to learn synonyms.
Bahuvrihi: मधुव्रत 'one whose vow is honey' = a bee. The compound describes something else.
Wordplay: अन्तकान्तक 'ender of the ender', since antaka (Yama) himself means 'the ender'.
